newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket - Slater, Bichel in Australia A side.
newsitem.headline: Cricket - Slater, Bichel in Australia A side.

text.p: Axed Australia opening batsman Michael Slater and Queensland pace bowler Andrew Bichel were chosen in the Australia A side to play West Indies in Melbourne next week, the Australian Cricket Board announced on Wednesday.

Slater was dumped from the senior Australia side at the start of the current test series against West Indies. Matthew Elliott, the man chosen to replace Slater, will be out of cricket for up to two months after injuring his knee during the second test on Monday.
Bichel took 10 wickets for Queensland in the Sheffield Shield match against Victoria which ended on Monday.
Australia A will be captained by national all-rounder Steve Waugh.

Australia A - Steve Waugh (captain), Andrew Bichel, Michael DiVenuto, Geoff Foley, Adam Gilchrist, Ian Harvey, Matthew Hayden, Michael Kasprowicz, Darren Lehmann, Michael Slater, Anthony Stuart, Andrew Symonds.
